title: LegacyProjectiles
description: Make projectiles ignore the player's velocity, like 1.8
body: # LegacyProjectiles LegacyProjectiles is a simple plugin that removes the player's velocity from launched projectiles, like they used to be prior to the combat update 1.9. No configuration, no commands, just plug and play! ## Requirements * Java 17 or newer * Server Software with Bukkit API. ## Support For bug reports and feature requests we'd prefer you use the [GitHub Issue Tracker](https://github.com/firewolf8385/LegacyProjectiles/issues). ## bStats
